message:
We had a little "I told you so" moment last week when our neighbor's tree came crashing down during a storm. 🌩️ We had been chatting about emergency plans a few days prior, and I casually mentioned the importance of having a go-bag ready. Fast forward to the storm, and there we were, feeling a bit smug that we had our supplies and documents organized. 

It reminded us how crucial it is to stay prepared, even when it feels like just a 'what if' scenario. Sometimes, those little moments can really highlight the value of being ready. 

What’s one simple preparedness tip you swear by?
